_doc: Shared by app/intent.py and app/intent.js (identical engines). Pattern syntax: space-separated elements; 'a/b/c' = one of; leading '?' = optional; '$cls' = a word of class cls (captures side/plural). A pattern only fires when it starts the clause (after a preamble) and every token after it is a tail modifier. SIDE: 'left' = the character's OWN left = rig suffix 'r' (CONTRACT side convention); side values in commands are rig suffixes 'l'|'r'|'both'. Lateral sign convention for targets: positive = toward SCREEN-RIGHT (head_yaw, body_yaw, body_lean, head_roll = top of head toward screen-right); head_pitch positive = chin down; gaze_y positive = up.

rules._note: whole utterance; fires on a final or once the partial has been stable (release is harmless)
the small vosk model hears a lone 'nod' as 'not'; whole utterance only

p: look up at the sky => dir=up

act._doc: whole-body moves + props (generated by tools/intent_bench/act_lexicon.py; see its docstring for the pattern syntax). Runs on raw clause tokens before the legacy rules; app/intent.py parse_act == app/intent.js.
moves: turn ?yourself all the way around/round <N> times
come back and talk/speak to/with me/us
